procedural_matters: ITA 7046 was represented by Brain Frabetti. DEN 9191 was represented by Alberte Klamer. Laura Neri ITA 7046 crew gave evidence as a witness for ITA 7046.
facts: 30 seconds before the second attempt to start race 5, Blue fleet, ITA 7046 and unidentified boat with both sailors wearing red lifejackets were lined up below close-hauled course on starboard tack, in the middle of starting line in the first row.
After 10 seconds, when the distance between the boats was around 10 cm, the unidentified boat's crew pushed back ITA 7046 with a hand on the port shroud.
DEN 9191 was sailing below close-hauled course on starboard tack in the middle of the starting line, closer to the pin end, and in the second row.
More than 1 minute after the incident ITA 7046 identified DEN 9191 boat, solely based on the red colour of their lifejackets.
conclusions: The Jury could not clearly establish that ITA 7046 identified the correct boat. Therefore the Jury could not clearly establish that it was DEN 9191 that broke RRS 2.
